pr_summary: Fix for Flink CDC runtime to handle transform rules (projection and filter expressions) that reference the same source column more than once. The fix modifies ProjectionColumnProcessor and TransformFilterProcessor to use LinkedHashSet instead of List to deduplicate column names while preserving order, preventing compilation errors when columns are referenced multiple times in expressions like 'col2 * col2 as square_col2' or filter conditions like 'col2 < 3 OR col2 > 5'.
